candidates.family: Parabolic Euler-Moulton and Lagrange central-configuration curves
candidates.summary: Exact algebraic H=C=0 curves exist for arbitrary positive masses, but they are precisely the known homothetic family whose tangent common-level variational equations provide no obstruction.

W1.reason: The central-configuration ansatz solves the full Newtonian equations exactly on s!=0.

W2.reason: Lagrange equilateral and Euler-Moulton branches cover arbitrary finite positive mass triples.

W3.reason: Every zero-angular-momentum member is the expressly excluded homothetic central-configuration curve.

W4.reason: The parabolic branch has exact H=0 and radial motion gives C=0 identically.

W5.reason: For the equal-mass control the phase curve is algebraic over C(s,kappa), kappa^2=5/2; the general central-configuration construction is algebraic after adjoining its roots.

W6.reason: All mutual distances are nonzero on the dense open scale parameter s!=0.

W7.reason: At the exact control point dH has a nonzero p_x component and dC has an independent p_y component.

W8.reason: The campaign stops this candidate at W3 and does not requalify the already-studied homothetic VE.

W9.reason: The pinned Combot source states that this double-zero homothetic VE is integrable at every variational order.

W10.reason: The analyzed algebraic open curve excludes the total-collision endpoint s=0.

W11.reason: The source-disjoint control reproduces the orbit and invariants, but candidate promotion stopped before an NVE reproduction was required.

W12.reason: All source payloads and exact-control inputs are hash-pinned and the reference imports no production module.
